top_current_affairs.title: Supreme Court Clarifies Guidelines on Arbitrary Demolitions ('Bulldozer Justice')
top_current_affairs.summary: The Supreme Court reiterates mandatory procedural safeguards, including advance notice and personal hearings, before any property demolition, emphasizing that executive overreach violates the Rule of Law and Article 21.
top_current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Important for constitutional law, fundamental rights (Article 21), rule of law, and judicial oversight of executive actions.

top_current_affairs.title: RBI Releases Updated Framework for Climate-Related Financial Risks
top_current_affairs.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has issued guidelines for Regulated Entities (REs) to incorporate climate risk management, green finance classification, and stress testing against extreme weather events.
top_current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Relevant for economic development, sustainable finance, climate risk integration in banking, and RBI's regulatory role.

top_current_affairs.title: India and ASEAN Finalize Scope for Reviewing the AITIGA Agreement
top_current_affairs.summary: India and ASEAN member states agreed on terms to revise the ASEAN-India Trade in Goods Agreement (AITIGA) to address trade deficits, non-tariff barriers, and supply chain resilience.
top_current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Crucial for Act East Policy, bilateral trade agreements, Indo-Pacific diplomacy, and regional integration.

top_current_affairs.title: Draft Rules Issued for the Indian Carbon Market (ICM)
top_current_affairs.summary: The Ministry of Power and MoEFCC released guidelines for the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS), establishing mechanisms for voluntary and compliance-based carbon offset trading for major industries.
top_current_affairs.upsc_relevance: Key topic for climate change mitigation, NDC commitments under the Paris Agreement, and market-based environmental instruments.

top_current_affairs.title: Cabinet Approves National Mission on Critical and Strategic Minerals
top_current_affairs.summary: The government launched a dedicated mission aimed at domestic exploration, processing capacity, and international acquisition of critical minerals like lithium, cobalt, and rare earth elements (REEs).
top_current_affairs.upsc_relevance: High relevance for energy transition, clean technology manufacturing, strategic autonomy, and mineral security.
